content.title: GLW Q4 Deep Dive: Optical Demand and Major Data Center Contracts Shape Outlook
content.summary: Glass and electronic component manufacturer Corning (NYSE:GLW) reported Q4 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 13.9% year on year to $4.41 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $4.25 billion was less impressive, coming in 0.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.72 per share was 2.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
